```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// ---- Membership summary ----------------------------------------------------
// Counts cover ALL approved members, including those not shown on the map.
// Apps Script writes them as rows of: metric, category, count.
summary = {
  const text = SUMMARY_URL
    ? await fetch(SUMMARY_URL, {cache: "no-store"}).then(r => r.ok ? r.text() : "metric,category,count")
    : await FileAttachment("data/demo-summary.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d => ({metric: d.metric, category: d.category, count: +d.count}));
}
summaryTotal = m => summary.find(d => d.metric === m)?.count ?? 0
summaryRows = m => summary.filter(d => d.metric === m)

html`<div class="rdn-tiles">
  <div class="rdn-tile"><div class="rdn-tile-label">Members</div><div class="rdn-tile-value">${summaryTotal("members").toLocaleString("en")}</div></div>
  <div class="rdn-tile"><div class="rdn-tile-label">Countries</div><div class="rdn-tile-value">${summaryTotal("countries")}</div></div>
  <div class="rdn-tile"><div class="rdn-tile-label">Continents</div><div class="rdn-tile-value">${summaryTotal("continents")}</div></div>
  <div class="rdn-tile rdn-tile-note">Counts include members who chose not to appear on the map. <a href="#rdn-summary">More about the membership ↓</a></div>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// ---- Load and tidy the public subset --------------------------------------
MULTI = ["approach", "systems", "organisms", "levels", "stressors", "regions"]

members = {
  const text = DATA_URL
    ? await fetch(DATA_URL, {cache: "no-store"}).then(r => {
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`Could not load member data (${r.status})`);
        return r.text();
      })
    : await FileAttachment("data/demo-members.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text)
    .map(d => {
      const out = {...d, lat: +d.lat, lon: +d.lon};
      for (const k of MULTI) out[k] = d[k] ? d[k].split(";").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [];
      out.display_name = d.name || "RDN member";
      return out;
    })
    .filter(d => Number.isFinite(d.lat) && Number.isFinite(d.lon));
}

// Options for each filter come from the data, so new categories appear automatically.
optionsFor = key => Array.from(new Set(members.flatMap(d => Array.isArray(d[key]) ? d[key] : (d[key] ? [d[key]] : [])))).sort()
```

mapContainer = html`<div class="rdn-map"></div>`

:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// ---- Apply filters: OR within a filter, AND across filters ------------------
filtered = {
  const anyOf = (vals, chosen) => chosen.length === 0 || chosen.some(c => vals.includes(c));
  return query.filter(d =>
    anyOf([d.career_stage], f_stage) &&
    anyOf(d.approach, f_approach) &&
    anyOf(d.systems, f_systems) &&
    anyOf(d.organisms, f_organisms) &&
    anyOf(d.levels, f_levels) &&
    anyOf(d.stressors, f_stressors) &&
    anyOf(d.regions, f_regions)
  );
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// ---- Map (created once; markers update when the filters change) ------------
// Use the Leaflet loaded in the page header (window.L), which has the cluster
// plugin attached. OJS's built-in `L` is a separate copy without it.
Leaf = window.L

leafletMap = {
  const m = Leaf.map(mapContainer, {worldCopyJump: true, minZoom: 2}).setView([25, 10], 2);
  // OpenStreetMap standard tiles: free, no API key; attribution required.
  Leaf.tileLayer("https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors',
    maxZoom: 12
  }).addTo(m);
  setTimeout(() => m.invalidateSize(), 100);
  invalidation.then(() => m.remove());
  return m;
}

cluster = {
  const c = Leaf.markerClusterGroup({showCoverageOnHover: false, maxClusterRadius: 40});
  leafletMap.addLayer(c);
  return c;
}

esc = s => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;"}[ch]))

safeUrl = u => /^https?:\/\//i.test(u || "") ? u : null

// Photos: https URLs from the live sheet, or relative paths for the demo photos.
safePhoto = u => /^https:\/\//i.test(u || "") || /^data\/demo-photos\/[\w-]+\.jpg$/.test(u || "") ? u : null

popupHtml = d => {
  const tags = [...d.approach, ...d.systems, ...d.organisms].map(t => `<span class="rdn-tag">${esc(t)}</span>`).join("");
  const web = safeUrl(d.website);
  const photo = safePhoto(d.photo_url);
  return `${photo ? `<img class="rdn-photo" src="${esc(photo)}" alt="Photo of ${esc(d.display_name)}" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" onerror="this.remove()">` : ""}
    <h4>${esc(d.display_name)}</h4>
    ${d.institution ? `<div>${esc(d.institution)}</div>` : ""}
    <div>${esc(d.city)}${d.city && d.country ? ", " : ""}${esc(d.country)}</div>
    ${d.career_stage ? `<div><em>${esc(d.career_stage)}</em></div>` : ""}
    ${d.interests ? `<div style="margin-top:0.35rem">${esc(d.interests)}</div>` : ""}
    ${tags ? `<div class="rdn-tags">${tags}</div>` : ""}
    <div style="margin-top:0.35rem">
      ${d.email ? `<a href="mailto:${esc(d.email)}">${esc(d.email)}</a>` : ""}
      ${d.email && web ? " · " : ""}
      ${web ? `<a href="${esc(web)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Website</a>` : ""}
    </div>`;
}

updateMarkers = {
  cluster.clearLayers();
  for (const d of filtered) {
    Leaf.circleMarker([d.lat, d.lon], {radius: 7, color: "#ffffff", weight: 2, fillColor: "#2a78d6", fillOpacity: 0.9})
      .bindPopup(popupHtml(d))
      .addTo(cluster);
  }
  if (filtered.length > 0 && filtered.length < members.length) {
    leafletMap.fitBounds(cluster.getBounds(), {padding: [30, 30], maxZoom: 6});
  } else if (filtered.length === members.length) {
    leafletMap.setView([25, 10], 2);
  }
  return filtered.length;
}
```

## Who's in the network {#rdn-summary}

All approved members, including those who chose not to appear on the map. Countries with fewer than three members are counted in the totals but not listed.

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-4}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Chart labels drop the "(e.g. ...)" examples from the form's career-stage options.
shortLabel = c => c.replace(/\s*\(e\.g\..*\)\s*$/, "")
CAREER_ORDER = ["Student (Bachelor’s or Master’s)", "PhD student", "Postdoctoral researcher",
  "Early-career independent researcher", "Established researcher", "Working outside academia",
  "Retired or emeritus", "Other"]

barChart = (rows, {title, order} = {}) => {
  const data = order
    ? rows.slice().sort((a, b) => order.indexOf(a.category) - order.indexOf(b.category))
    : rows.slice().sort((a, b) => d3.descending(a.count, b.count));
  const max = d3.max(data, d => d.count) || 1;
  return Plot.plot({
    title,
    width: 380,
    height: 30 + data.length * 30,
    marginLeft: 230,
    marginRight: 36,
    x: {axis: null, domain: [0, max]},
    y: {label: null, domain: data.map(d => d.category), tickSize: 0},
    style: {fontSize: "12px", color: "#212529"},
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(data, {y: "category", x: "count", fill: "#2a78d6", insetTop: 6, insetBottom: 6, rx: 4,
                       title: d => `${d.category}: ${d.count} member${d.count === 1 ? "" : "s"}`}),
      Plot.text(data, {y: "category", x: "count", text: d => d.count, dx: 5, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#52514e"}),
      Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: "#ced4da"})
    ]
  });
}

barChart(summaryRows("career_stage").map(d => ({...d, category: shortLabel(d.category)})), {title: "Career stage", order: CAREER_ORDER})
```
